newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends stronger in light trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends stronger in light trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed stronger on Monday at C$1.3662 (US$0.7320) from Friday's close at C$1.3674 (US$0.7314) in light holiday trading, dealers said.
* They said one major European order to buy the Canadian currency early in the day bolstered the currency.
* The unit is expected to stick to the same range Tuesday.
In economic news on Monday, the Finance Department said Canada's budget deficit narrowed sharply in October to C$0.5 billion from C$2.9 billion a year earlier.
Traders said the news did not affect the currency.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1370 marks from Friday's close of 1.1352 marks, but slid to 83.43 yen from 83.53 yen.
